eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, w = g.weapon, inp = g.input, K = g.deer; g.audio.unlock(); window.__K = K; window.__look = (pt) => { const e = g.engine.camera.position; const dx = pt.x - e.x, dy = pt.y - e.y, dz = pt.z - e.z; p.yaw = Math.atan2(-dx, -dz); p.pitch = Math.atan2(dy, Math.hypot(dx, dz)); p.update(1 / 30); g.engine.camera.updateMatrixWorld(); }; window.__scope = (on) => { if (on !== w.aimToggled) inp.buttonsPressed |= 4; for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) { p.update(1 / 30); w.update(1 / 30); inp.endFrame(); } }; window.__fire = () => { for (let i = 0; i < 90 && w.state !== 'ready'; i++) { p.update(1 / 30); w.update(1 / 30); inp.endFrame(); } inp.buttonsPressed |= 1; w.update(1 / 30); inp.endFrame(); for (let i = 0; i < 400 && !g.hunting.lastShot; i++) g.hunting.update(1 / 60); return g.hunting.lastShot || { kind: 'nada', zone: null, distance: Infinity, lethal: false, points: 0 }; }; p.position.set(-29, g.terrain.heightAt(-29, -28), -28); p.velocity.set(0, 0, 0); g.chunks.warmup(p.position); for (let i = K.active.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) K.release(i); return { veadosIniciais: K.active.length, mata: +g.biome.forest(-29, -28).toFixed(2) }; })()
